name: guybrush
description: Guybrush, a young blond pirate: spiky blond hair tied in a ponytail with a red ribbon, a cheeky grin, a navy-blue long coat with gold buttons and gold trim over a white open-necked shirt with white cuffs, a red sash at the waist, dark grey trousers, brown folded-top boots, and a thin steel rapier with a gold basket hilt in his LEFT hand
hands: the rapier stays in his left hand on the screen-right side and his right hand is an empty fist on his hip on the screen-left side

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back, the rapier is lifted up over the head with its tip pointing up and back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and slightly crouched, the rapier cocked behind the head with its thin blade hanging down behind the shoulders, the empty right fist tucked in
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips forward, the arm sweeps over the head and the thin blade is level, pointing to the lower-right
strike.4: contact: rapier arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the thin blade slashing down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the empty right fist swung back for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the thin blade carries on down until its tip nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, the blond ponytail and coat tails trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the rapier lifts back toward the ready angle

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the empty right fist flung out to the left, rapier arm thrown up and out)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further, knees bent, the rapier dipping, the empty right fist still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, rapier arm flung up, the empty right fist drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the rapier lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the rapier's tip resting on the ground, the empty right fist hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the rapier slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left; the rapier lies on the ground at the lower-right
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the blond ponytail flops
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the rapier on the ground beside him
